fact_text: Hub Power's corporate briefing on 2 Sep 2026 cited an initial target of assembling 25,000 BYD vehicles a year through Mega Motors, with management saying the figure could be raised later.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: The analyst said investors should look at the Mega Motors EV assembly business rather than the IPP business, which he saw as the new source of growth.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: The Maple Leaf and Pioneer Cement merger swap ratio of 2.65 has been announced.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: Pioneer Cement's stake in Maple Leaf is cited as about 77.7%, which the analyst said already sits inside the Maple Leaf structure before the swap.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: Maple Leaf's annual capacity is cited as about 7 million tonnes, and the analyst expects it could rise above 10 million tonnes once Pioneer's plant is combined and run harder.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: Pioneer's plant had been running below 40% capacity utilisation, which the analyst said leaves room for the combined group to lift output.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: Maple Leaf trades at about USD 85 to 86 per tonne of enterprise value on a standalone basis, which the analyst treated as a key cement valuation metric.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: Pioneer's own enterprise value was about USD 40 per tonne, far below Maple Leaf, and the analyst expected the merger to narrow that gap as revenue and profitability expand.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: Engro Fertilizer's recent data was slightly better after some stuck inventory was released, but its share price has fallen a long way, and the analyst called it a value investment.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: Meezan Bank approved about PKR 31 to 32 billion for the government's Apna Ghar housing finance scheme, which the analyst said should help bank lending and advances.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: As of 3 Sep 2026, government officials said about 5,300 loans had been approved under the Apna Ghar housing scheme.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: A housing-finance push lifts construction activity, which flows through to cement, paints, steel, rebar and flat steel makers, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: Flat steel makers, including Aisha Steel and international steel, posted better results for the April to June 2026 quarter, and the analyst said the trend could continue if conditions hold.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: The Shewa and Spinwam Waziristan blocks are operated by Mari Energies with OGDC as a partner, and the market is still waiting for their development timing.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: The analyst said quarterly dividends at OGDC and PPL have edged up since gas-sector collections improved, and that the government would also want stronger payouts.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: National Bank trades well below its book value, and the analyst argued it should pay quarterly dividends as private and Islamic banks do.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)

fact_text: Bank of Punjab's dividend has been declared, which the analyst had said would move it into a dividend-yield category, and it also trades well below book value.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC 25,000 EV Target| E&P Rotation & Bank Yields | Midday Flash 03 Sep 2026' (YouTube, 2026-09-03)
